reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin providing a draggable, per-conversation dock of dashboard cards for usage, context, tasks, images, commands, and related session utilities.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端提供可拖拽、按会话保存布局的小组件面板，用于查看用量、上下文、任务、图像和会话工具信息。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable, per-conversation widget dock to the DeepSeek Harness web client for usage, context, task, image, and session utility information.

capabilities: Displays draggable per-conversation widget panels in the DeepSeek Harness web client
Stores layout and configuration data in browser localStorage
Can use a user-provided DeepSeek API key to display balance and usage information
Can connect to configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints for image description
Can query configured GitHub repository information
